faq.q: How many weapons are there in GTA 6?
faq.a: 66 standard weapons: 53 guns, 9 melee weapons and 4 explosives. On top of those come the named weapon variants, which are tracked separately and listed in the [unique weapons guide](/guides/unique-weapons/).

faq.q: How many weapons do you need for 100% in GTA 6?
faq.a: Any 50 of the 66 standard weapons. Variants don't count. The quickest way is to buy what you're missing at one of the six Expanded gun stores, and to pick up what enemies drop along the way.

faq.q: Where can I see which weapons I have unlocked?
faq.a: In the pause menu under **Progress › Weapons**. It counts standard weapons and variants apart.

faq.q: Where do you buy sniper rifles and launchers in GTA 6?
faq.a: Only at the Expanded Ammu-Nation stores. They also carry the two machine guns. There are six of them; hover over a gun store's map icon to see its type, or check the [list of gun stores by county](/guides/shops/#ammu-nation).

faq.q: Where do my weapons go in GTA 6?
faq.a: Weapons you've bought and variants you've found wait in the weapon locker at any Ammu-Nation, and you can also take them from your vehicle's trunk.
